candidates.name: Pemphigus
support_spans: Revealed epidermal erosion with suprabasal epidermal splitting with acantholysis
Direct immunofluorescence of perilesional skin showed intercellular deposition of IgG and C3 throughout epidermis
Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay showed high level of IgG autoantibodies: Against desmoglein 1: 40 IU/mL (normal value: 20 U/mL)
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and test results, including epidermal erosion, suprabasal epidermal splitting, and high levels of IgG autoantibodies against desmoglein 1 and 3, are consistent with a diagnosis of Pemphigus.
